title: Celadon_Sewers
lead_summary: Team Rocket have a hideout within Celadon Sewers. After defeating all grunts in the sewer portion, the player will be able to take ladders to access Celadon City without taking the floating planks.

items.name: Ultra Ball
items.location_details: On the lower ground, East of the entrance.

items.name: Super Repel
items.location_details: On the higher ground, pass Team Rocket Virginia.

items.name: Full Restore
items.location_details: On the higher ground, pass Team Rocket Max.

items.name: TM34 Sludge Wave
items.location_details: On the lower ground, pass the first PC, inside the small black tunnel.

items.name: Black Sludge
items.location_details: On the higher ground, pass the second PC, beyond the three wooden plank bridge.

items.name: PP Up
items.location_details: On the lower ground, pass Team Rocket Lionel.

items.name: Antidote
items.location_details: On the higher ground, pass Team Rocket Lionel.

items.name: TM68 Giga Impact
items.location_details: On the higher ground, after surfing East to a secondary room.
